events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit ancestry, holds and publishes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin main 2>&1|tail -2; git merge-base --is-ancestor 512c734 origin/main && echo ANCESTOR; git show --stat --format=%s 512c734 | tail -15; grep -n -i "publish held\|hold" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md 2>/dev/null | tail -8; grep -n "PUBLISHED" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | tail -3 | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find probes, compare captures with live mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls app/scripts | grep -i -E "guide|anonym"; grep -n "only" app/scripts/probe-guides* | head -5; lsof -ti:4322 | head -2; cd /tmp && rm -rf t135m && git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live t135m 2>&1|tail -1; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; n=0; for f in $(git show --name-only --format= 512c734 | grep webp); do rel=${f#app/public/}; m=$(find /tmp/t135m -path "*$rel" | head -1); if cmp -s "$f" "$m"; then n=$((n+1)); else echo "DIFF $rel ($m)"; fi; done; echo identical=$n

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect probe options, run check-guides
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -n -i -E "only|BASE|localhost|argv|env\." scripts/probe-guides.mjs | head -12; node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4322/debug/guides

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check debug guides only param
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -rn "only" src/app/debug/guides/ 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -n '"dev"\|"start"' package.json

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start dev server on port 4391
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; nohup npx next dev -p 4391 > /tmp/t135-dev.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/t135-dev.pid; for i in $(seq 1 60); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:4391/debug/guides?only=s6-sms"); [ "$c" = 200 ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo $c

events.text: Dev server is up; running probe-guides per guide now.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-guides on the 8 guides
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for g in s5-webinar-stages s5-challenge-stages s5-rsp-stages s6-sms s4-challenge s4-rsp s2-tantra-pro-funnel s1-overview; do nohup node scripts/probe-guides.mjs "http://localhost:4391/debug/guides?only=$g" > /tmp/t135-pg-$g.log 2>&1; echo "$g: $(tail -1 /tmp/t135-pg-$g.log)"; done
